scope: One actual compiled even-sector sufficient-comparison target K, not the full classical Weil form or a physical source counterexample. No parameter change or Gram rerun.
principal_block_binding: Exactly K[indices,indices] from the whole-target SHA256 in bindings; not a block in physical source coordinates.

normalized_coordinate_rayleigh.norm_role: Euclidean in the compiled K congruence coordinates; not the native physical norm

independent_method: Read actual K; check all224x224 symmetry and all224 vector entries; sum diagonal plus twice strict-upper terms on support; no worker import and no Decimal arithmetic.
consequence: K has a strict negative direction. Under the paid positive nonsingular congruence, this fixed sufficient matrix P0 is not PSD. This does not imply M+Kcompact+U<0 or full classical Q<0.

gram_audit_qualifier.causal_reading: Code writes even-gram proposal before ValueError, then calls traceback.print_exc before writing NONPASS; audit log itself has no event timestamps. Attribution to exception reporting is a code-path inference, not an ordered timestamp trace.
